Fix `plugins/catalog/src/components/CatalogEntityPage/useEntityFromUrl.ts` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. major (line 157): The returned loading value (loading || formerLookup.loading || Boolean(redirectTo)) does not match when the former-ref lookup actually applies. (1) When getEntityByRef resolves to undefined, the render that commits first has loading=false and formerLookup.loading=false, because the previous no-op run already settled. useAsync only sets loading=true in its effect after commit, so 'Entity not found' flashes before the redirect. Plan rule 6 forbids this. (2) On every normal load and on every refresh(), the entity change re-runs the no-op lookup, which sets formerLookup.loading=true for one render, so EntityLayout flashes <Progress /> after the entity has loaded. Tests only assert the final state, so neither shows up. Confidence: high (react-use useAsyncFn sets loading:true inside the effect). — fix: Compute `applicable = !!name && !loading && !error && !entity && !!catalogApi.getEntityRefByFormerRef`. Make the lookup always resolve to `{ fromRef, toRef | undefined }` for the current ref, including in the catch. Then return `loading: loading || (applicable && formerLookup.value?.fromRef !== currentRef) || Boolean(redirectTo)` and ignore formerLookup.loading when the lookup does not apply.

Fix `plugins/catalog-backend/src/service/createRouter.ts` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. minor (line 552): For current/none/conflict the handler calls auditorEvent.success() and then throws NotFoundError inside the same try, so the catch also calls auditorEvent.fail(). Each 404 records both outcomes. The by-name route has the same pattern (writeSingleEntityResponse throws after success()), so this follows existing code, but it is still a double-terminated audit event. — fix: For the 404 branches, call fail() only, or call success() and throw outside the try. Keep it consistent with whatever the maintainers prefer for by-name.
2. minor (line 555): logger.warn fires on every request for a conflicting former ref, so any authenticated caller can make repeated warn lines by hitting the endpoint. — fix: Consider logger.debug, or rate-limit or de-duplicate the warning per ref (for example a small in-memory Set with TTL).

Fix `plugins/techdocs/src/reader/components/TechDocsRedirectNotification/TechDocsRenamedNotice.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. minor (line 32): The notice text comes from the `renamedFrom` query param, so a crafted link shows 'This entity was renamed from <anything>' (text only, no XSS). In TechDocs the param is also never removed, so it stays in shared or bookmarked URLs and the notice comes back on every reload. The same spoofing applies to the catalog alert in useEntityFromUrl.ts, though catalog removes the param. — fix: Remove renamedFrom after showing the notice (replace navigation), as the catalog hook does. Optionally carry the marker in navigation state instead of the query string so it cannot be forged by a link.
